contentText: After weeks of escalating attacks and fears of an even wider war, President Donald Trump says the US and Israel have agreed to pause further strikes on Iran if a deal to end the conflict can be reached quickly. The announcement marks a dramatic change in tone after Trump recently warned Iran it would be hit "very hard". Iran swiftly denied there was any such agreement, dismissing Trump's account and casting fresh doubt over whether diplomacy is any closer.
